_comment: Weather and season definitions. Owned by the Gameplay Programmer (crops/weather). Seasons are Level 3 / Conditional scope, but the data lives here now so that adding them later is a content change rather than a code change.

weather_types.forecast_text: Clear and mild. Normal water use.
Hot today. The soil will dry out much faster than usual.
Overcast. Less water lost to evaporation.
Rain expected. You should not need to irrigate today.
Heavy storm. Soil may become waterlogged.
Drought conditions. Water is being lost fast and there is no rain coming.

_seasons_comment: Level 3 / Conditional scope (C2). Weights are the relative chance of each weather type on any given day in that season. The Baseline uses 'summer' only.

seasons.teaching_note: Maize is a summer crop in South Africa, planted with the summer rains from about October to December.
Cooler, drier weather suits beans and makes them easier to dry down for storage.
Most of South Africa's summer-rainfall region grows little in winter without irrigation. Planting maize now is a costly mistake.
Spring is planting season. Getting seed in the ground before the rains arrive is the single biggest decision of the year.
